subject: Re: Contract renewal — scale x2 reserved GPU pool & SLA alignment
messages:
From: Jen Mitchell <jen.mitchell@brightshop.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning — capacity spike next quarter

Hi Marissa, Neha,

Our contract with Redwood comes up for renewal in late May and we are projecting a roughly 2x increase in inference demand for Q3 due to a new feature rollout. Current reserved pool is 8 GPUs. We need to understand pricing and operational assurances for moving to a 16-GPU reserved pool starting at contract renewal.

Specifically:
- Can you guarantee throughput ranges for the x2 configuration (p50/p95 token latency and tokens/sec) for our baseline model (r-infer-3b-q8)?
- What are the lead times for activating the additional GPUs and any staged ramp options?
- Impact to monthly commit and whether you can offer a credit or phased billing since we're ramping usage over 6–8 weeks.

I attached our usage report for Q1 to this note. Procurement will want an amendment with clear SLA language and a path to rollback if we miss latency targets. I'm looping procurement on copy.

Thanks,
Jen Mitchell
Head of Product
BrightShop

Attachment: usage_report_Q1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jen Mitchell <jen.mitchell@brightshop.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T12:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity spike next quarter

Hi Jen — great to hear about the new feature, congrats.

Quick answers to start:
- Throughput: for your baseline model on 16 GPUs we target ~3.5–4.5M tokens/hour under continuous batching for typical sequence lengths (we'll validate with your exact prompt mix). p95 latency depends on batching window — we can keep p95 under 450ms with a low-latency policy and modest batching, or push higher throughput by allowing a slightly larger batching window. I'll ask Karthik to run a short perf sim against your usage_report_Q1 to give concrete numbers.
- Lead time: we can reserve capacity in 48–72 hours once the amendment is signed; activation for live traffic typically completes within 7 calendar days for a phased rollout (can be faster in our US east region).
- Billing: we can propose a 3-month phased billing where month 1 is 50% of the delta, month 2 75%, month 3 full 100% for the additional GPUs — or we can do an immediate commit with a one-time onboarding credit. Neha, what flexibility do we have on one-time credits?

Next step: Karthik — can you run a perf estimate and a short SLA draft (p50/p95 token lat targets + remediation steps) so we can send a formal amendment to Procurement?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jen Mitchell <jen.mitchell@brightshop.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — capacity spike next quarter

Thanks Marissa — ran a short simulation using the sequences in usage_report_Q1. High level:
- For r-infer-3b-q8 on 16xA100-equivalent slots using our low-latency routing, expected steady-state throughput ~4.0M tokens/hour. p50 token latency ~110ms, p95 ~420–470ms for typical prompt lengths (50–250 tokens).
- If BrightShop wants guaranteed p95 <400ms under a saturated workload, we'd recommend enabling prefix KV caching and a small request prioritization window; that reduces throughput by ~8–12% but gives better tail latency.
- Activation plan: we recommend a 2-week staged activation — week 1 reserve and smoke tests, week 2 gradual traffic transfer with rollback hooks. That minimizes customer risk.

I've attached a short SLA metrics table and an ops playbook for the staged activation.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SLA-throughput-metrics.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jen Mitchell <jen.mitchell@brightshop.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Draft amendment for 2x reserved capacity (internal review)

Team —

I'm preparing the amendment for BrightShop (deal BD-3482) to move from an 8-GPU reserved pool to a 16-GPU reserved pool at renewal with the phased billing option Marissa suggested. Key points in the draft:
- Monthly commit increases from current baseline to reflect additional 8 GPUs; line item with both full-month and phased-month billing sequence.
- SLA table: p50/p95 token latency guidance (as Karthik supplied) with an operational remediation window and credit formula if p95 exceeds target for 3 consecutive days.
- Activation/rollback plan: 2-week staged activation; rollback triggers and telemetry to be shared with BrightShop prior to cutover.
- Billing and credits: propose a one-time onboarding credit of 15% of the first-month delta if BrightShop signs within 30 days. Finance to confirm margin impact.

Laura — can you please review the amendment language for procurement concerns (liability, rollback rights, data handling)? Rishi — can you confirm we can offer a 15% onboarding credit and provide the revised invoice numbers (PDF) so we can attach to the DocuSign packet?

I've attached the current draft amendment (Redwood-Dedicated-Amendment-v2.pdf) for comment. I'll incorporate legal and finance feedback and send an external version back to Jen and Procurement.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood-Dedicated-Amendment-v2.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jen Mitchell <jen.mitchell@brightshop.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final amendment & next steps — BrightShop (BD-3482)

Hi Jen —

Thanks for the details and for your patience while we pulled the internal approvals together. Attached is the final amendment and the billing path that implements the 3-month phased billing plus the 15% onboarding credit (if signed within 30 days). Highlights:
- Effective date: contract renewal date (as discussed).
- Activation: 2-week staged activation window; rollback triggers and observability hooks included.
- SLA: p50/p95 targets documented; credit formula spelled out (service credit equal to 5% of monthly delta for every day p95 exceeds target beyond the 3-day remediation window, capped at 30% max per month).

Next steps for BrightShop:
1) Legal/procurement: review and sign the amendment. DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/brightshop-amendment
2) Finance: review invoice PDF attached and confirm payment terms by reply.
3) Ops kickoff: we'll schedule the activation runbook review with Karthik and our SRE team once signed.

Jen — happy to hop on a short call tomorrow to walk through any line items.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
